spec.title: peer connections
spec.description: realtime websockets the leader keeps to other servers: desired (demanded by local subscriptions) vs current (established)

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(concrnt_chunkline_cache_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", cache="itr", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(concrnt_chunkline_cache_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", cache="itr"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (instance) (rate(concrnt_chunkline_cache_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", cache="body", result="hit"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance) (rate(concrnt_chunkline_cache_requests_total{instance=~"$instance", cache="body"}[$__rate_interval]))
topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (service, method, url, le) (rate(concrnt_echo_request_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", service=~"$service"}[$__rate_interval]))) > 0)

spec.title: Services
spec.description: proxied services and the version each reports via /cc-info

spec.title: WebPush sends / sec
spec.description: result is ok, error (no response) or the push service's HTTP status; a rising 410 means dead subscriptions

spec.title: Offline peers
spec.description: peers the federation client currently backs off from

spec.title: Offline peer hosts
spec.description: empty while every peer is reachable

spec.title: Peer request failures / sec
spec.description: non-2xx answers and transport errors (code="error"), by peer

spec.title: Peer request latency p90 by host
Dead-lettered jobs
spec.description: jobs that exhausted their retries; replay with conctl once the cause is fixed

spec.title: Backlog
spec.description: shared across replicas (max, not sum). ready: unclaimed, pending: claimed but not acked, retry: waiting for backoff, dlq: dead-lettered

spec.title: Connection pool
spec.description: per replica; "in use" pinned at max means the pool is saturated

spec.title: Pool wait time / sec
spec.description: seconds per second spent waiting for a free connection; anything sustained above 0 is contention

spec.name: service
spec.label: service
spec.description: which service answered the request: proxied services by their configured name, in-process handlers as "concrnt"
